selection_basis: Use the recorded Industrial process for the complete white Sculpted faucet with the selected Sculpted layer and support settings.
wall_generators: Retain base Arachne for the continuous reinforced foot; other rigid parts retain Classic.
scope: Print process transferred from the accepted black Industrial faucet; white Sculpted physical finish and fit require this complete print.

base_underside.method: Scaffold with a sloped roof and a sloped skin

edge_support_strategy.selection_quote: I'm quite convinced that we need to do this everywhere, that we've got these rough edges on overhangs.
edge_support_strategy.method: Keep the rim contact mapping inboard of the exterior wall and follow the seat with the first rim perimeter.
edge_support_strategy.application: The full base starts on the sloped scaffold and its insert recesses bridge. Tip trees feed the shoulder roof with release breaks and clearance from the mating plug.

mounting_plate_counterbores.scope: Leave the screw head and shank passages clear. Bridge each counterbore shoulder in the flat mounting plate.

tip_supports.method: Slim trees at the mating shoulder with dense roof sections, a contoured first perimeter and a hidden-root disc
tip_supports.root_contact_scope: Hidden male insertion terminal end only. The directly bonded disc leaves a scuff; do not transfer this bonded contact to visible surfaces.
tip_supports.tree_support_scope: The mating lip has a scoped dense roof and the inboard dispense face has a separate outlet keepout.
tip_supports.selection_quote: That worked. That disc works in this case, and is removable, but it leaves a bit of a scuff that would be a problem on a visible surface, but since its on the male insertion portion that is hidden, we are golden here.

tip_dispense_contact.scope: Carry the dense interface to the inclined inner dispense face. Keep the actual outlet mouth clear for its bridging paths. The mapping fades out inboard of the tube's outside wall.

tip_end_cooling.scope: Part cooling on the tip's model paths from its dispense face back to just short of the lip grooves, on both sides. Every other path keeps its native cooling.
tip_end_cooling.selection_quote: I want you to turn on part cooling for the area I highlighted in red there. You just need part cooling on for those surfaces that are rough on both sides, as you can see in the photos.

annotation_clarification: The 0.24 mm layers are the normal model layers; no separate eight-layer override is necessary when the fine bands are absent.
